{{Top|leg}}
'''Simonelle''' was a unique [[Ingoian]] replica [[Droid/Legends|droid]], modeled after [[Gender/Legends|his]] creator, [[Simonelle]] the Ingoian, an outlaw [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who also created the [[Human replica droid]] [[Guri]]. Guri destroyed the Ingoian replica droid, believing she was [[Death/Legends|killing]] the genuine Simonelle, on orders from her master, [[Dark Prince|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate. Xizor had planned to eliminate Simonelle to ensure that Guri remained a unique creation.
